            Success, Object = pcall(Drawing.new, Type)

            self.__Objects[Index] = setmetatable({ __SELF = Object, Type = Type }, {
                __call = function(self, Properties)
                    local Object = rawget(self, '__SELF'); if IsSynapse and not Object.__OBJECT_EXISTS then return false, 'render object destroyed' end
                    if Properties == false then Object.Visible = false; Object.Transparency = 0; Object:Remove(); return true end
                    if typeof(Properties) == 'table' then
                        for Property, Value in pairs(Properties) do
                            local CanSet = true

                                spawn(function()

                                    Property = 'ScaleFactor'; Value = Value.X / self.DefaultSize.X; Object[Property] = Value
                                end)
                            end
                            if CanSet then Object[Property] = Value end
                        end
                    end
                    return Object
                end
            })
            Object.Visible = true; Object.Transparency = 1
            if Type == 'Text' then
                if Drawing.Fonts then Object.Font = Drawing.Fonts.Monospace end
                Object.Size = 20; Object.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); Object.Center = true
                Object.Outline = true; OutlineOpacity = 0.5

local LastRayIgnoreUpdate, RayIgnoreList = 0, {}
local function CheckRay(Instance, Distance, Position, Unit)
    local Pass = true; local Model = Instance
    if Distance > 999 then return false end
    if Instance.ClassName == 'Player' then Model = GetCharacter(Instance) end
    if not Model then Model = Instance.Parent; if Model.Parent == workspace then Model = Instance end end
    if not Model then return false end
    local _Ray = Ray.new(Position, Unit * Distance)
    if tick() - LastRayIgnoreUpdate > 3 then
        LastRayIgnoreUpdate = tick()
        table.clear(RayIgnoreList)
        table.insert(RayIgnoreList, LocalPlayer.Character)
        table.insert(RayIgnoreList, Camera)
        if Mouse.TargetFilter then table.insert(RayIgnoreList, Mouse.TargetFilter) end
        if #IgnoreList > 64 then while #IgnoreList > 64 do table.remove(IgnoreList, 1) end end
        for i, v in pairs(IgnoreList) do table.insert(RayIgnoreList, v) end
    end
    local Hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(_Ray, RayIgnoreList)
    if Hit and not Hit:IsDescendantOf(Model) then
        Pass = false
        if Hit.Transparency >= 0.3 or not Hit.CanCollide and Hit.ClassName ~= 'Terrain' then table.insert(IgnoreList, Hit) end
    end
    return Pass
end

local function IsVisible(Player)
    if not Options.VisCheck.Value then return true end
    
    local character = GetCharacter(Player)
    if not character then return false end
    
    local head = character:FindFirstChild('Head')
    if not head then return false end
    
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not rootPart then return false end
    
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local targets = {
        head.Position,
        rootPart.Position,
        (head.Position + rootPart.Position) / 2
    }
    
    for _, target in pairs(targets) do
        local direction = (target - origin).unit
        local distance = (target - origin).Magnitude
        
        if distance < 5 then return true end
        
        local ray = Ray.new(origin, direction * distance)
        local hit, position = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {
            LocalPlayer.Character,
            Camera,
            character
        })
        
        if not hit then
            return true
        end
        
        if hit:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

local function CreateBillboardText(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    
    local Text = NewDrawing('Text'){
        Size = Options.TextSize.Value,
        Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        Center = true,
        Outline = Options.TextOutline.Value,
        OutlineOpacity = 0.5,
        Visible = false,
        Transparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 3,
        Font = Drawing.Fonts and Drawing.Fonts.Monospace or 3
    }
    
    BillboardDrawings[player] = {
        Text = Text
    }
    
    local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = GetCharacter(player)
        local text = BillboardDrawings[player]
        
        if not text or not character or not Options.Enabled.Value then
            if text and text.Text then text.Text.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        
        local head = character:FindFirstChild('Head')
        if not head then
            text.Text.Visible = false
            return
        end
        
        if Options.VisCheck.Value and not IsVisible(player) then
            text.Text.Visible = false
            return
        end
        
        local Vector, OnScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + V3New(0, 2.5 + Options.YOffset.Value / 100, 0))
        
        if OnScreen then
            local distance = (Camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude
            if distance > Options.MaxDistance.Value then
                text.Text.Visible = false
                return
            end
            
            local info = {}
            
            if Options.ShowName.Value then
                local name = player.Name
                if CustomPlayerTag then
                    local tag = CustomPlayerTag(player)
                    if tag and #tag > 0 then name = name .. tag end
                end
                table.insert(info, name)
            end
            
            if Options.ShowHealth.Value then
                local health = 100
                if GetHealth then
                    health = GetHealth(player) or 100
                elseif character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then
                    health = math.floor(character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid').Health)
                end
                table.insert(info, string.format('[%s HP]', health))
            end
            
            if Options.ShowDistance.Value then
                table.insert(info, string.format('[%sm]', math.floor(distance)))
            end
            
            if #info == 0 then
                text.Text.Visible = false
                return
            end
            
            local color
            if Rainbow then
                color = Color3.fromHSV(tick() * 128 % 255 / 255, 1, 1)
            elseif Options.ShowTeamColor.Value then
                color = player.TeamColor.Color
            elseif CheckTeam(player) then
                color = TeamColor
            else
                color = EnemyColor
            end
            
            text.Text.Text = table.concat(info, ' ')
            text.Text.Color = color
            text.Text.Size = Options.TextSize.Value
            text.Text.Outline = Options.TextOutline.Value
            text.Text.Position = V2New(Vector.X, Vector.Y)
            text.Text.Visible = true
        else
            text.Text.Visible = false
        end
    end)

-- Oynani surish va Ekran ichida saqlash (Clamping)
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.AbsolutePosition
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local newX = startPos.X + delta.X
		local newY = startPos.Y + delta.Y
		
		local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
		local frameSize = mainFrame.AbsoluteSize
		
		newX = math.clamp(newX, 0, viewportSize.X - frameSize.X)
		newY = math.clamp(newY, 0, viewportSize.Y - frameSize.Y)
		
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, newX, 0, newY)
	end
end)
